main_text.p: ærario similiter accrescit. Reliqua præte-reo, ne modum operis excedant; & quæ restant de Reip. formâ, in civitate expediam.
main_text.head: FORMA REIP. IN URBE, ET MAGISTRATUUM ORDO.
main_text.p: FORMA Reip. in urbe ARISTO-CRATICA est, modicè in DEMOCRATIAM declinans quam exponere nunc animus est, Antiquitus, cùm minor adhuc civitatis fortuna esset, RATIONALES quatuor, OL-DERMANNI VIIISENA-TUS. eam administrarunt. Nunc verò ab annis amplius trecentis CONSULES quatuor summum locum in eâ tenent dignitatis. His additi olim XVI, nunc & proximis sæculis XII SENATORES: qui omnes senatum conficiunt, totius Reip. caput. Penes hunc senatum est jurisdictio urbana, potestasque in rebus urbanis edicendi, decernendi, vocandi, prehendendi, in custodiam dandi, coëtcendi, supplicia extrema

page.notes: The first word of the body is a drop capital F joined to "ORMA". Small capitals are given as capitals. The printed "OL-" / "DERMANNI" is joined as "OL-DERMANNI" because the hyphen is printed at the line end. The margin note "SENA-TUS." is taken from its two printed lines. The digitiser mark in the lower right corner is left out.
